title_en: Shanghai Guanlong Valve Machinery Co., Ltd. v. Tang Maolin — labor contract dispute
ruling_gist_en: Where an employer has a clear requirement for the academic degree of applicants during recruitment, and the applicant provides a false academic degree certificate and concludes a labor contract with the employer, this constitutes a situation where the labor contract is concluded by fraudulent means and shall be null and void as provided in Article 26 of the Labor Contract Law of the PRC. The employer may rescind the labor contract in accordance with Article 39 of the Labor Contract Law of the PRC.
